title: Top Account Intake: Timeboxed Runway + Consensus Scoring Procedure
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: high-touch top-account requests flood the intake queue and create long-lived, un-scored asks that block prioritization and engineering capacity planning. Current approaches (ad-hoc meetings, one-off executive advocacy lanes) lead to brittle promises and misaligned expectations.

Goal: define an operational intake procedure that (1) ensures every top-account escalation is evaluated within a fixed 'runway' window, (2) surfaces a reproducible consensus score that combines customer value, technical effort, and operational risk, and (3) yields a deterministic outcome (commit / defer / scoped pilot) with next-action and SLA.

This ticket delivers the playbook, scoring rubric, lightweight tooling requirements (a triage form + Slack bot + dashboard card), and rollout plan to pilot with three enterprise accounts in Q2. The emphasis is process automation and timeboxing rather than adding another subjective queue.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published with step-by-step runbook (intake -> scoring meeting -> outcome -> communication template)
Scoring rubric defined with weights for: Customer Value (40%), Technical Effort (25%), Operational Risk (20%), Strategic Signal (15%)
Automated intake form created in Confluence (or Drive form) that pre-populates fields necessary for scoring
Slack triage bot posts new top-account intake to #pm-triage and creates a draft dashboard card in Console for tracking
Pilot with three accounts completed: each intake resolved within 21-day runway and outcomes recorded
Post-pilot retrospective with stakeholders and an updated rollout checklist
success_metrics: % of top-account asks resolved within 21 days >= 90% during pilot
Median time-to-decision for top-account intake <= 10 days
Reduction in open, unscored top-account tickets > 50% after 8 weeks
implementation_notes: Scoring formula: Score = 0.4*Normalized(CustomerValue) - 0.25*Normalized(TechEffort) - 0.2*Normalized(OperationalRisk) + 0.15*Normalized(StrategicSignal). Values normalized to 0-100 then scaled.
Technical Effort multiplier: if cross-team infra work required (ENG dependencies list), multiply effort by 1.25 for runway allocation
Runway policy: Intake expires after 21 days unless explicitly extended by PM + ENG owner with justification logged
Fallback path: For high-risk/high-value items that fail scoring threshold, propose 'Scoped Pilot' with 4-week gated plan rather than full commit
Tooling MVP: simple Drive form feeding a Google Sheet + Zapier -> Slack post; long-term: integrate into Console intake card via Insights API
